name: Cal.com
summary: Scheduling platform for booking links, teams and developers, with a v2 API, embeddable React components and Cal Sans.
description: Cal.com is scheduling software and infrastructure: share a booking link and let invitees pick a time, with round-robin and collective scheduling, routing forms, workflows, payments and native video. Developers get a v2 REST API, embeddable React atoms and an MCP server; designers get the downloadable open-source Cal Sans UI and Text variable typeface. The commercial product is closed source; the self-hostable community edition Cal.diy is MIT licensed.
contains: free forever plan for individuals; Teams $12 and Organizations $28 per user/month
API v2 with OAuth or API keys; embeddable React atoms
MCP server and AI scheduling agent support
Cal Sans v2 variable font with three optical sizes, free download
100+ app integrations, payments, workflows and Cal Video
